c: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: finished original A4 portrait cover concept for adult vegetable-growing cheat sheets, also usable as a contemporary website hero or promotional poster. Output a flat front-on artwork, no physical book mockup. Exact text only: 'Vegetable Growing', 'CHEAT SHEETS', 'Practical advice. At a glance.' No brand name, no other words. Modern digital-product design sensibility: bold rounded geometric sans-serif, strong hierarchy, fresh very light background, playful but sophisticated. Title and vegetables must interlock in a single dynamic composition, not a title at top with a still life illustration underneath. Maintain clear readable letters while leaves and stems weave behind and slightly in front of selected edges. No formal serif, no vintage seed packet, no border, no decorative wreath, no symmetrical frame, no botanical watercolour, no realistic study, no crosshatching, no thin-line illustration, no browser chrome or fake buttons. Include a coloured rounded rectangular strip carrying 'CHEAT SHEETS'. A few confident vegetable shapes, not visual clutter. Text accurately spelled. Portrait ratio 1:1.414. Direction C: vivid flat vector-like editorial graphics with a fresh off-white background, ink-green extremely large heavy rounded sans-serif title broken into three tightly stacked lines 'Vegetable' / 'Growing' / orange rounded strip 'CHEAT SHEETS'. Asymmetrical diagonal layout. Oversized stylised carrot, cut-open purple onion, red tomato and curving green pea pod are scattered THROUGH the typography at different scales and angles, with big flat leaves and softly rounded graphic forms. One carrot threads behind the title and reappears below, pea pod curves around a letter, tomato partly overlaps the strip's far right end without hiding text. Use solid rich vegetable colours and minimal two-tone shading, crisp contours, an occasional restrained soft shadow only for layering. Several vegetables crop boldly off the outer canvas. Title dominant, generous breathing room, abundance from large scale and overlapping not a pile or decorative frame. A light apricot rounded irregular panel behind part of the central composition provides the suggestion of an app widget. Tagline small clean sans-serif along bottom. Fresh, energetic, grown-up, impeccably composed.

Direction D: a polished contemporary web-app campaign with softly dimensional sculptural vegetables made of smooth matte coloured material. Rounded tactile forms, simplified recognisable carrots, purple onion, green pea pod, tomato and leafy cabbage; no faces, no eyes, no toy characters, no drawing-class still life. Pale mint/off-white background with warm pale apricot rounded panels occupying selected uneven parts of the composition. Extremely bold rounded dark-green geometric sans-serif title split into 'Vegetable' and 'Growing', huge and left aligned through the middle of the cover. Vegetables orbit the letters asymmetrically, one carrot leans behind and in front of the left edge of the word Growing and a pea pod loops through the negative space to the right. Giant tomato partly cropped at bottom right, cabbage cropped upper left; freely scattered not arranged on a tabletop. A bright coral-orange rounded strip below title carries white 'CHEAT SHEETS'. The strip and some type sit at slightly different depths; all text readable. Crisp large shapes, delicate contact shadows, diffuse soft light, bright clean premium web illustration. Small sans-serif tagline at bottom. Lots of intentional light negative space. Not realistic or vintage.
